verdict.rationale: A test/sandbox environment is a fair question for an email API platform, but the evidence never documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. Pods, scoped API keys and the free tier are multi-tenancy, access-control and pricing features, which are adjacent and not a sandbox. A community commenter in fact urged the team to build local dev and testing tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
